text:
Maya Singh: Quick one 1: Maria Gomez (EU time CET) has an onsite loop scheduled for Mon Jun 1 but she needs a US visa appointment first. Candidate asked if Redwood can pre-approve interview travel and cover visa appointment fees. Also requested hotel the night before due to flight timing. Can ops advise?

Devon Lee: We usually pre-approve travel for final onsite interviews. Need approval from hiring manager + finance. @Priya can you confirm budget code and whether we can advance visa fee?

Priya Rao: Hiring manager ok. Finance policy allows visa fee reimbursement or direct payment for travel under candidate relocation. For visa fee advance: we need candidate passport copy and signed travel advance form. Evelyn, can you handle the vendor payment if approved?

Evelyn Park: Yep. I'll prepare a travel advance packet and create a PO for visa service if finance approves. Candidate prefers hotel near Embarcadero and pickup from SFO. Also flagged a dietary restriction (halal).

People Ops Bot: Created travel request draft (#TR-7721). Status: pending finance approval. Calendar hold for interview 2026-06-01 09:00-13:00 PDT (candidate CET 18:00-22:00). Invite includes Zoom fallback.

Devon Lee: Candidate flight options look like arriving Sun evening. If we cover hotel night of Sun May 31, that's fine. Also confirm expense code: ENG-HIRE-TRAVEL. Priya please confirm.

Priya Rao: Confirmed expense code ENG-HIRE-TRAVEL. Finance will reimburse visa fees or pay vendor directly. We can also provide a $100/day per diem for meals. Evelyn, please add halal catering note to lunch order.

Maya Singh: Candidate asked about airport pickup and whether Redwood can book a rideshare or arrange volunteer pickup. Travel Ops, can we book rideshare from SFO to hotel and back to office next day?

Travel Ops: We can pre-book a corporate rideshare credit and send an e-voucher to candidate. Also can reserve shuttle if preferred. Will need arrival flight details by 2026-05-25 to confirm.

Evelyn Park: Filed hotel reservation at Embassy Suites (block under "Maria Gomez"). Parking not needed. Catering request updated: halal meal for candidate, veg options for panel. Elevator access note not needed.

Priya Rao: Security note: Do not include door codes in calendar invites. Send secure email with arrival PIN and front desk instructions. Draft to send to candidate once visa/flight confirmed.

Maya Singh: Also asked about interview tech setup: candidate prefers to borrow a MacBook with Chrome + corp VPN. Can we provision Linux image? She primarily uses macOS; loaner Mac is fine. Evelyn, please file device request.

Evelyn Park: Loaner MacBook request submitted (ticket #DO-5014). Pickup instructions: front desk 08:30-09:00 on interview day, bring ID. Drive folder link for panel docs: https://drive.redwood/recruiting/maria_gomez

People Ops Bot: Secure email scheduled after travel approval. Items to include in secure email: arrival PIN, hotel confirmation, rideshare voucher, visa receipt instructions, per diem details, loaner pickup window.

Devon Lee: Hiring panel availability all set. I'll upload a short take-home prompt and a 1-pager.

Maya Singh: One last thing 1: Maria requested a short campus accessibility note (stairs vs elevator). Evelyn added building accessibility details to the invite. All set from my side. Closing unless someone needs more. :white_check_mark:
